NOTICE OF POST-ELECTION TABULATION

The Holyoke City Clerk’s Office will conduct a post-election tabulation of ballots received by mail after Election Day, provided they were postmarked on or before November 3, 2026.

A total of five (5) ballots will be hand-counted as part of this process.
